# nadakit

> Wav2vec 2.0 on Modular MAX, plus the embed engine and FastHTML app from nadayantra

[Wav2vec 2.0](https://arxiv.org/abs/2006.11477) on [Modular MAX](https://docs.modular.com/max/). This package combines the `nada` model API with the embed runtime that `nadayantra` and the gananayantra helper each used to keep a copy of.

An embedding is the mean final hidden state over the clip, minus a fixed typical-audio vector (`embed_center.npy`), scaled to unit length.

## Modules

- [nadakit.audio](https://alix559.github.io/nadakit/audio.html.md): Wav2vec 2.0 encoder, as `Wav2Vec2Model` runs it at inference.
- [nadakit.config](https://alix559.github.io/nadakit/config.html.md): Shapes for the wav2vec 2.0 base checkpoint.
- [nadakit.download](https://alix559.github.io/nadakit/download.html.md): Download `facebook/wav2vec2-base-960h` and write a numpy checkpoint.
- [nadakit.features](https://alix559.github.io/nadakit/features.html.md): Waveform preparation and CTC decoding for the wav2vec 2.0 checkpoint.
- [nadakit.layers](https://alix559.github.io/nadakit/layers.html.md): Building blocks the MAX graph needs that are not in `max.experimental.nn`.
- `nadakit.make_center`: Compute the "typical audio" vector that `Engine.embed` subtracts.
- [nadakit.model](https://alix559.github.io/nadakit/model.html.md): Wav2vec 2.0 with a CTC head.
- `nadakit.warm`: Compile the CPU graphs the app actually runs.
- [nadakit.weights](https://alix559.github.io/nadakit/weights.html.md): Load a wav2vec 2.0 state dict onto the MAX module.
